title: Why Houses Got So Expensive
description:
In 1970, the typical new American home sold for about $23,000. Today it's about $393,000, almost twice as expensive even after inflation.

Penny the coin breaks down the housing crisis with real data: how many years of income a home costs, why America stopped building enough homes, how zoning rules block new housing, how mortgage rates pushed prices up and then made payments jump, whether it was easier in 1984, who wins and loses, and what would actually help.
